title: An over-glorified tea light
text:
An over-glorified tea light. Tiny. Barely a scent. Definitely not fig. No glass so it melted all over the saucer I placed under it. Lasted for just a few hours.
Never again.

product_metadata.title: Tyler Votive Fragrance Candle 2 Oz,Mediterranean Fig
description: Tyler Candle boxed votives make a perfect gift for yourself or anyone. Tyler uses the finest quality waxes and opulent fragrance oils available to create the ultimate aroma experience. Each candle is hand-poured, ensuring even burning and maximum fragrance saturation. Burn time 15 hours. A fresh fruity green bouquet underlined by floral melon and marine note on a drydown of sandalwood and musk.
